name: record_arrival
description: Record whether the patient has reached the hospital. Call this once, only after they have clearly said yes or no.

attempt_id.description: Internal attempt reference from the call context. Filled in automatically; never ask for it and never say it.

arrived.description: yes if the patient has reached the hospital, no if they have not arrived yet.

contact_person.description: Name or role of the person who answered, if they said it.

to_number.description: The number you called. Filled in automatically; never ask for it.
